title: NEXT Competition 2026 - Field 3, West Campus
note: Narration follows the NEXT Competition 2026 Rules (August 7, 2026): sections 1, 2.2, 2.3, 3.1, 3.2, 4, 4.3, 4.4 and 5.6. Edit it here, then run simulator/tools/cutscene/make_voiceover.py to regenerate the audio and timings. Captions are ASCII: the built-in UI font has no other glyphs.

beats.caption: NEXT Competition 2026
beats.narration: This is the NEXT Competition, on Field 3 at George Mason University's West Campus.

beats.caption: Red Alliance vs Blue Alliance: one 90-minute match
beats.narration: Two alliances, Red and Blue, play one ninety-minute match on a regulation soccer field, and swap sides at halftime.

beats.caption: Your Base: the only place to touch a vehicle
beats.narration: Each alliance commands from its Base tent. The Base is the only place a person may touch a vehicle.

beats.caption: 99 tennis balls in each penalty box
beats.narration: Ninety-nine tennis balls start in each penalty box. Collect them, and launch them into your buckets.

beats.caption: Red scores in orange, Blue scores in blue
beats.narration: Red scores in the orange buckets on Blue's half of the field. Blue scores in the blue buckets on Red's half.

beats.caption: Ground: 1 or 2 points. Elevated: 3 or 6 points
beats.narration: A ground bucket near midfield is worth one point, and two deep in enemy territory. Raised to one meter, they are worth three and six.

beats.caption: Tagged: frozen for 15 minutes
beats.narration: Hit an opposing vehicle with a launched ball to tag it. A tagged vehicle is frozen for fifteen minutes.

beats.caption: -7 points: ball out of bounds or bucket knocked over
beats.narration: Every ball shot out of bounds, and every bucket knocked over, costs seven points.

beats.caption: W A S D to drive, Space to stop
beats.narration: You drive CrabTrapBot for the Red Alliance. Use W, A, S and D to drive, and Space to stop. Good luck.
